description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把电动10系列混凝土泵的动力文字印成：电机功率是15 kW。电机格是电机上的千瓦。柴油格只写这一页真正印出的发动机行。画面「Check valve」的主体是Inside hastelloy 单向阀, wafer configuration。它不改这一格动力，也不会把柴油机代号抄到电动行上。

h1.en: Which Power Cell Electric 10 Series Concrete Pump Prints
h1.zh: 电动10系列混凝土泵的动力格子印了什么

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery prints the Electric 10 Series Concrete Pump power text in Xingtai as: Motor Power is 15 kW. An electric motor cell is kilowatts on a motor. A diesel cell names the engine line that is actually printed. The frame “Check valve” shows Inside hastelloy check valve, wafer configuration. It does not change this power cell, and a diesel code is not copied onto an electric row.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把电动10系列混凝土泵的动力文字印成：电机功率是15 kW。电机格是电机上的千瓦。柴油格只写这一页真正印出的发动机行。画面「Check valve」的主体是Inside hastelloy 单向阀, wafer configuration。它不改这一格动力，也不会把柴油机代号抄到电动行上。

heading.en: Read the power label that is present
heading.zh: 只读已经印出的动力标题

body.en: Motor Power is 15 kW. Electric drive and diesel drive are different supplies. Use the label on this sheet, not the neighbouring model's label. Theoretical Output remains 21 m³/h. Max. Outlet Pressure remains 23 MPa.
body.zh: 电机功率是15 kW。电动和柴油是两种供电。用这一页的标题，不用旁边那个型号的标题。理论输送量仍是21 m³/h。最大出口压力仍是23 MPa。

heading.en: A power-unit frame is not a nameplate
heading.zh: 动力装置画面不是铭牌

body.en: The frame is from en.wikipedia.org, “Check valve”, and its subject is Inside hastelloy check valve, wafer configuration. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not lift kilowatts or an engine code out of that frame. If this row has no voltage cell, none is invented.
body.zh: 这一帧来自 en.wikipedia.org 的「Check valve」，主体是Inside hastelloy 单向阀, wafer configuration。河北品锦机械不从这一帧里提取千瓦或发动机代号。这一行如果没有电压格，就不编一个电压。

heading.en: Power does not set the pipe size

body.en: Hopper Capacity 0.1 m³. Max. Aggregate Size 2 cm and below. Main Unit Weight 400 kg. Those cells, when printed, stay in their own columns. A larger motor cell is not a longer pipeline.
body.zh: 料斗容积 0.1 m³。最大骨料粒径 2 cm and below。整机重量 400 kg。这些格子如果印了，就留在各自的列里。电机千瓦更大，并不等于管路更长。

question.en: What power text does Electric 10 Series Concrete Pump print?
question.zh: 电动10系列混凝土泵的动力文字是什么？

question.en: Can a diesel code be moved onto this row?
question.zh: 可以把柴油机代号挪到这一行吗？

answer.en: Only if this row already prints it. Otherwise the cell stays as written.
answer.zh: 只有这一行已经印了才能算。否则格子保持原样。

question.en: Does the frame show the Xingtai kilowatts?
question.zh: 这一帧显示了邢台的千瓦吗？

answer.en: No. Kilowatts are taken from the catalogue cell, not from the frame.
answer.zh: 没有。千瓦取自目录格，不取自这一帧。

question.en: What are output and pressure on this sheet?
question.zh: 这一页的输送量和压力是多少？

answer.en: Theoretical Output is 21 m³/h. Max. Outlet Pressure is 23 MPa.
answer.zh: 理论输送量是21 m³/h。最大出口压力是23 MPa。
